info.title: AuthKit APIs Documentation
info.description: API documentation for AuthKit authentication and authorization.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all users using cursor-based pagination.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The unique user ID used as a cursor for pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of users to return.

X-Total-Count.description: Total count of users in the system.

X-Page-Count.description: Total number of pages available based on the limit.

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific user.

delete.description: Deletes a user account and all associated data.

get.summary: Fetch all sessions of a user
get.description: Retrieves all active sessions for a specific user using cursor-based pagination.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the user.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The unique session ID used as a cursor for pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of sessions to return.

X-Total-Count.description: Total count of active sessions for the user.

X-Page-Count.description: Total number of pages available based on the limit.

delete.summary: Revoke all sessions for a user
delete.description: Revokes all active sessions for a specific user.

post.description: Promotes an existing user to the ADMIN role.

400.description: Invalid input or user not found

post.description: Registers a new OIDC client and returns the generated Client ID and Client Secret. Ensure you save the secret as it will not be shown again.

201.description: Client registered successfully with auto-generated Client ID and Secret

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of security audit logs with optional filters.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor ID for pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records to return.

get.summary: Fetch audit log details by ID
get.description: Retrieves details of a specific security audit log entry.

post.description: Creates a new user account and sends a verification email.
Verifies the user's email address using a code.

404.description: User not found or already verified

post.description: Resends the verification email to the user's email address.
Authenticates a user and returns access/refresh tokens.

400.description: Too many failed attempts - Account temporarily locked for 15 minutes

post.description: Logs out the authenticated user and clears session.
Generates a new access token using a refresh token.
Sends a password reset OTP to the user's email.

400.description: Invalid email or user not found

post.description: Verifies the OTP sent to the user's email.
Resets the user's password using the verified token.

400.description: Passwords do not match or invalid input

post.description: Changes the user's password.

get.description: Returns a simple message indicating the server is running.
Checks the basic health of the application services.
Provides a detailed health report including external dependencies.

post.description: Sends a magic link to the user's email address. Optionally accepts an OIDC interaction UID.
Verifies the magic link token and authenticates the user. Resumes OIDC flow if uid is present.
Generates a QR code for setting up Multi-Factor Authentication.
Verifies the MFA setup using a code and returns backup codes.
Revokes the MFA setup for the user.
Verifies MFA code during login process.

401.description: Invalid code or token or User not authenticated

get.description: Redirects the user to Google for authentication. In Swagger UI, this can be triggered via the "Authorize" button if googleOAuth is configured.

parameters.name: redirectUrl
parameters.description: Optional redirect URL to return to after login

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Optional OIDC interaction UID

get.description: Handles the callback from Google OAuth authentication.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The authorization code returned by Google

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The state parameter for CSRF protection

200.description: OAuth login successful, redirects to frontend

get.description: Retrieves details of an OIDC interaction. If a valid Direct API session exists (via `refreshToken` cookie), this endpoint automatically logs the user in (Session Bridge).

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Interaction UID

post.description: Submits user credentials for an OIDC login interaction. If MFA is enabled, it returns `mfaRequired: true`.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Interaction UID

post.description: Confirms an OIDC interaction (e.g., consent).

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Interaction UID

get.description: Aborts an OIDC interaction.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Interaction UID

post.description: Verifies MFA code and completes the OIDC login.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Interaction UID

get.description: Returns the OIDC Provider configuration and supported metadata.
Returns the public keys used to verify tokens signed by this provider.
Starts the OIDC Authorization Code flow. Redirects to interaction endpoints if login/consent is needed.

302.description: Redirects to login, consent or redirect_uri.

post.description: Exchanges an Authorization Code for Access, Refresh, and ID Tokens.

get.description: Returns claims about the authenticated user.

post.description: Validates a token and returns its active state and meta-information.
Revokes a given token.

get.description: Retrieves all active sessions for the current user using cursor-based pagination.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The unique session ID used as a cursor for pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of sessions to return.

X-Page-Count.description: Total number of pages available based on the limit.

delete.description: Revokes all active sessions except the current one.

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific session.
Retrieves the profile of the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Generates cryptographic options and random challenge for registering a new passkey.
Verifies authenticator attestation response and persists the passkey credential.

400.description: Verification failed or credential already registered

post.description: Generates assertion options and random challenge for passwordless passkey login.

email.description: Optional user email for identified-user passkey login

post.description: Verifies passkey assertion, logs in user, creates session, and issues tokens.

200.description: User signed in successfully via passkey

400.description: Assertion verification failed or challenge expired

post.description: Verifies passkey assertion as a secondary factor during MFA challenge.

400.description: Assertion verification failed or challenge expired

get.description: Returns all passkey authenticators registered to the authenticated user.

delete.description: Deletes a passkey authenticator owned by the authenticated user.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Authenticator ID

patch.description: Updates the friendly name/label of a registered passkey.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Authenticator ID

post.description: Creates a new event webhook subscription. Generates a cryptographically secure signing secret.

400.description: Invalid payload or SSRF restricted URL

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of webhook subscriptions.
Retrieves details of a specific webhook subscription.

patch.description: Updates configuration, URL, events, or status for a webhook subscription.

400.description: Invalid input or SSRF restricted URL

delete.description: Permanently deletes a webhook subscription and its delivery history.

post.description: Rotates the signing secret for a webhook endpoint with a 24-hour dual-signature grace window.
Triggers a signed `webhook.test` event delivery attempt to verify receiver endpoint health.

get.description: Retrieves paginated delivery history records for a webhook subscription.
Retrieves detailed information for a specific delivery attempt.
